O.outcome_detail: reported use of peer evaluation in TBL implementation

cells.quote: "Approximately one-third of the studies (10/37) reported incorporating peer evaluation, though methods varied considerably."
cells.note: The exact 10/37 finding is reported in the wiki entry, not in the supplied study text. The study text states: "Limited reporting of the use of the ‘4S’ framework in application design and peer review was noted."
